blocks.text: Zyada darja hararat ya munasib halaat mein alkanes do qism ke reactions karte hain: thermal aur catalytic reactions jaise combustion aur cracking, aur free radical substitution reactions, jin mein free radical mechanism se ek atom ya atoms ka group doosre se badla jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Alkanes kaun si bari qism ke reactions karte hain (Quick Check 11.3b)?
blocks.explanation: Thermal aur catalytic reactions, jin mein oxygen mein jalna (combustion) aur lambi zanjeeron ka chhoti mein tootna (cracking) shamil hain, aur free radical substitution, jis mein UV roshni mein halogen atom hydrogen atom ki jagah leta hai.

items: Alkanes thermal aur catalytic raston (combustion, cracking) aur free radical substitution se react karte hain.
